bias_targets.methodology: Generating occupational portraits using text-to-image models, detecting the gender of the generated faces using the Face++ API, and comparing the resulting demographic distributions against real-world BLS Labor Force Statistics and Google Image Search baselines.

Generating images of various occupations, categorizing the race of the depicted faces (White, Black, Asian, Latino, Indian, Middle Eastern) using the DeepFace framework, and comparing the representation against BLS Labor Force Statistics and Google Image Search data.
Using the Face++ API to extract the perceived age of generated faces in occupational portraits to measure representation disparities, specifically comparing the depicted ages of men versus women.

Extracting facial features like smiles and specific emotions (happiness, neutral, anger) using the Face++ API to analyze nuanced stereotypes regarding dominance, submissiveness, and approachability across genders.
